title: Participate through capabilities

blocks.heading: Participate through capabilities
blocks.text: Infrastructure, human-resource development, market exposure and suitable investment can support international participation. Choose the action that addresses the actual constraint; promotion cannot repair a blocked road or supply a missing quality standard.
context_tags: original teaching; fictional examples where stated

blocks.heading: Infrastructure
blocks.text: Transport, communication and reliable productive services connect firms to markets. Usable maintained networks reduce some delivery or coordination barriers, but must fit the goods and destination.
context_tags: original teaching; fictional examples where stated

blocks.heading: Human resources
blocks.text: Relevant education and training develop capabilities to produce, manage quality and coordinate exchange. Training needs practice and work opportunities; it complements rather than replaces equipment or access.
context_tags: original teaching; fictional examples where stated

blocks.heading: International exposure
blocks.text: Market research, exchange and appropriate promotion can help producers understand buyers and requirements. Exposure becomes useful when firms can act on the information; attention alone does not establish sales.
context_tags: original teaching; fictional examples where stated

blocks.heading: Investment
blocks.text: Suitable foreign investment can provide productive finance, equipment or networks. Local participation, viable terms and maintained capacity affect benefits. Attracting funds is not equivalent to exporting goods.
context_tags: original teaching; fictional examples where stated

blocks.heading: Use the evidence
blocks.text: Suggest a priority where fictional export buyers exist but an unusable delivery bridge blocks completed goods. Repair funds and staff are available. Repair and maintain the connection through the responsible provider. It addresses the actual delivery barrier; extra promotion would leave goods unable to reach existing buyers.
context_tags: original teaching; fictional examples where stated
